snippet.title: Beat The Markets - How To Play (English)
snippet.description:
Beat The Markets is a turn-based digital board game based on investing in the stock market. Play with 2 - 6 players in this competitive financially based game inspired by 80s style board games and family game night. Players will buy investments and sell them to gain capital and sabotage their opponents with cards. Play is based on dice rolling and cards. The winner of the game is the player with the most cash on hand when the markets close at the end of the month.

Wishlist The Game Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095440/Beat_The_Markets/

Features:
- Local Multiplayer
- Online Multiplayer
- Steam Achievements
- Leaderboards

Disclaimer: The artwork for Mr Rich was generated with with AI. We will be replacing it prior to launch
